# @sharadox/sharadox-web-library

> Sharadox's own website library (verifiable source, not open source): content, branded components, styles and contact configuration for sharadox.com, built on the open-source @sharadox/*-web-library topic libraries.

- content/locale LOCALES (defineLocales en/pt); content/style STYLES (color group: black default, white, system; storageKey "style"); content/separator SEPARATOR "·"
- utility/separate separate(...parts) with the Sharadox separator
- action/send-contact sendContact(form, ip) — createContactAction to contact@sharadox.com, subject "Contact · Name (Company)"
- component/*: navigation, hero (+ lazy globe), service-index, statement, services (+ visuals), touchpoint, capability, marquee, process, contact (+ form), footer, section-indicator, style-switch, structured-data, share-image (renderShareImage)
- style/token Sass helpers: tint, shade, dashed, on-scroll, below, fill-center
- License: Sharadox Verifiable Source License 0.1.0 (read and verify only)
- component/license License({ locale, markdown }) renders the license page body (marked); content/license LICENSE { path "/license", title, eyebrow, description }
- Navigation, Footer and LanguageSwitch take path? (e.g. "/license"): section links go to /<locale>#section, language links stay on the page; the footer links to the license page
- component/not-found NotFound({ locale, path }) the 404 screen (giant 404 with the live globe as the zero, failed request line, way home); content/not-found NOT_FOUND; ServiceIndex takes base? ("/<locale>" off the home page)
- content/slogan SLOGAN (with full stop) and SLOGAN_LINES; content/section SECTION { home, services, touchpoints, capabilities, process, contact } with id + names; content/action ACTION.startProject; content/language LANGUAGE { label, names }. SITE.slogan, HERO.lines, HERO.primary, NAVIGATION.<name>, FOOTER.services/language, CAPABILITY.eyebrow and CONTACT.eyebrow were removed in 0.10.0 in favor of these.
- Language switch (internationalization-web-library 0.2): entrances skip on soft navigation (hero/not-found Motion initial, Sass mixin skip-entrance($durations...) for CSS entrances); site must render <LocaleTransitionStyle /> in <head>
- Service card actions: SERVICES.items[].actions [{ need, label }] render as ServiceActions (component/service-action) linking to #contact and calling requestContactNeeds (utility/contact-need, window event CONTACT_NEED_EVENT); ContactForm ticks the chips with a glow. Contact choices: website, platform, mobile-app, brand-identity, social-media, marketing-campaign, other
- content/site FOUNDED 2026; the footer's copyright years come from CopyrightYears (@sharadox/time-web-library): "2026", then "2026–<current year>" as years pass
- utility/llms-text llmsText() → sharadox.com's llms.txt (shared shape from @sharadox/metadata-web-library). The cookie panel was removed in 0.14.0: the site stores only what it needs (language, style), which needs no consent.
- content/privacy PRIVACY (privacy-web-library options) and PRIVACY_PAGE { path "/privacy", title, eyebrow, description }; component/privacy-page PrivacyPage({ locale }); the footer links it
- 0.16.0: chevron icons from @sharadox/icon-web-library replace every text arrow (button, footer Back to top, 404)
